attributes.action: Exclude rapists and child sex offenders from early release schemes
attributes.additional_details: Victims of rape and child sexual abuse live with the consequences of these crimes for life. Any further reduction in the time served by those convicted of these offences risks undermining public confidence in the justice system and causing further distress to victims and families. The Government should ensure anyone convicted of rape, child rape, child sexual abuse or child sexual exploitation is permanently excluded from any current or future early release or sentence reduction scheme.
attributes.background: We want the UK Government to permanently exclude anyone convicted of rape, child rape, child sexual abuse or child sexual exploitation from any current or future early release or sentence reduction scheme.

rejection.details:
The Government has already excluded prisoners guilty of rape and child sex offences from being eligible for the early prisoner release scheme.

You can read more about this here: https://www.gov.uk/government/news/rape-serious-child-sex-and-grooming-offences-barred-from-sentencing-changes

If you'd like something else, you could start a new petition clearly explaining what it is.
